title: A Protocol-Guided LLM Agent for Quantum Program Synthesis and Execution
summary: This study evaluates a protocol-guided large language model (LLM) agent workflow for quantum program synthesis and execution. A versioned YAML protocol specifies interface and quantum-semantic requirements while leaving circuit design to the model. The workflow combines Qiskit circuit generation, evaluator-guided repair, and quantum processing unit (QPU) deployment. A matched ablation evaluates four LLM endpoints using the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) for H$_2$, the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for MaxCut, and Fashion-MNIST quantum-kernel classification.
